column3: “made a mockery of” renders “dealt ruthlessly with”; “the Egyptians” renders “Egypt,” and “grandson” renders “son of your son.”
“the surface of the land” renders “the eye of the land.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the Egyptians” renders “Egypt,” and “grandfathers” renders “fathers of your fathers.”
“we must hold a feast to the LORD” renders “a feast of the LORD is ours.”
“evil is in your mind” renders “evil is before your faces.”
“the surface of the whole land” renders “the eye of all the land.”
“shifted the wind to” renders “turned”; “the Red Sea” renders “Sea of Reeds (Yam Suph).”
“sky” renders “the heavens”; “a darkness which may be felt” renders “that they may feel darkness.”
“thick darkness” renders two Hebrew words for darkness, “darkness of gloom.”
Close to the Hebrew; “one another” renders “a man his brother.”
“You must also let us have” renders “you also will give into our hand.”
